# Pear Digitals

> Earnings press releases of every US-listed company, from SEC EDGAR, and fair values for NYSE and Nasdaq stocks. Not investment advice.

## Earnings releases

Each company's results press release (8-K Item 2.02 / 6-K Exhibit 99.1) is on the site within about a minute of SEC accepting the filing. New releases get an analysis built from the filing alone (headline numbers, segments, margins, KPIs, guidance, what drove it); every release, back to 2016, has its full text and financial statements.

- [Latest release](https://peardigitals.com/earnings/aapl/): /earnings/<ticker>/, with the company's earlier releases listed
- [As Markdown](https://peardigitals.com/earnings/aapl/index.md): add index.md to any earnings page
- [One release](https://peardigitals.com/earnings/aapl/2025-10-30/): /earnings/<ticker>/<filed date>/
- [Sitemap](https://peardigitals.com/earnings/sitemap.xml): every release page

## Fair value

- [Fair values](https://peardigitals.com/fmv/): bear, base and bull per share for S&P 500 stocks
- [MCP server](https://peardigitals.com/mcp/)
